<tei:body xmlns:tei="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xmlns:j="http://jewishliturgy.org/ns/jlptei/2">
      <tei:div facs="https://archive.org/download/mahzor-lyom-rishon-shel-rosh-hashanah-day-one-jenny-marmorstein-1965/page/n350.jpg">
        <tei:p><tei:pb ed="1965" facs="https://archive.org/download/mahzor-lyom-rishon-shel-rosh-hashanah-day-one-jenny-marmorstein-1965/page/n350.jpg"/><tei:milestone unit="chapter" n="24" corresp="urn:x-opensiddur:text:bible:psalms/24"/><tei:milestone unit="verse" corresp="urn:x-opensiddur:text:bible:psalms/24/1" n="1"/>לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר. לַ<j:divineName>ייָ</j:divineName> הָאָרֶץ וּמְלוֹאָהּ תֵּבֵל וְיֹשְׁבֵי בָהּ: <tei:milestone unit="verse" corresp="urn:x-opensiddur:text:bible:psalms/24/2" n="2"/>כִּי הוּא עַל־יַמִּים יְסָדָהּ. וְעַל־נְהָרוֹת יְכוֹנְנֶהָ: <tei:milestone unit="verse" corresp="urn:x-opensiddur:text:bible:psalms/24/3" n="3"/>מִי־יַעֲלֶה בְהַר <j:divineName>יְיָ</j:divineName>. וּמִי־יָקוּם בִּמְקוֹם קָדְשׁוֹ: <tei:milestone unit="verse" corresp="urn:x-opensiddur:text:bible:psalms/24/4" n="4"/>נְקִי כַפַּיִם וּבַר לֵבָב. אֲשֶׁר לֹא־נָשָׂא לַשָּׁוְא נַפְשִׁי וְלֹא נִשְׁבַּע לְמִרְמָה: <tei:milestone unit="verse" corresp="urn:x-opensiddur:text:bible:psalms/24/5" n="5"/>יִשָּׂא בְרָכָה מֵאֵת־<j:divineName>יְיָ</j:divineName>. וּצְדָקָה מֵאֱלֹהֵי יִשְׁעוֹ: <tei:milestone unit="verse" corresp="urn:x-opensiddur:text:bible:psalms/24/6" n="6"/>זֶה דּוֹר דֹּרְשָׁו. מְבַקְשֵׁי פָנֶיךָ יַעֲקֹב סֶלָה: <tei:milestone unit="verse" corresp="urn:x-opensiddur:text:bible:psalms/24/7" n="7"/>שְׂאוּ שְׁעָרִים רָאשֵׁיכֶם וְהִנָּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵי עוֹלָם. וְיָבוֹא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד: <tei:milestone unit="verse" corresp="urn:x-opensiddur:text:bible:psalms/24/8" n="8"/>מִי זֶה מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד. <j:divineName>יְיָ</j:divineName> עִזּוּז וְגִבּוֹר <j:divineName>יְיָ</j:divineName> גִּבּוֹר מִלְחָמָה: <tei:milestone unit="verse" corresp="urn:x-opensiddur:text:bible:psalms/24/9" n="9"/>שְׂאוּ שְׁעָרִים רָאשֵׁיכֶם וּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵי עוֹלָם. וְיָבֹא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד: <tei:milestone unit="verse" corresp="urn:x-opensiddur:text:bible:psalms/24/10" n="10"/>מִי הוּא זֶה מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד. <j:divineName>יְיָ</j:divineName> צְבָאוֹת הוּא מֶלֶךְ הַכָּבוֹד סֶלָה: <tei:milestone unit="verse"/><tei:milestone unit="chapter"/></tei:p>
      </tei:div>
    </tei:body>

<tei:body xmlns:tei="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xmlns:j="http://jewishliturgy.org/ns/jlptei/2">
      <tei:div corresp="urn:x-opensiddur:text:siddur:rosh_hashanah/kiddush">
        <tei:pb ed="1965" n="22" facs="https://archive.org/download/mahzor-lyom-rishon-shel-rosh-hashanah-day-one-jenny-marmorstein-1965/page/n35.jpg"/>
        <tei:head xml:lang="he">סֵדֶר קִדּוּשׁ.</tei:head>
        <tei:note type="instruction" facs="https://archive.org/download/mahzor-lyom-rishon-shel-rosh-hashanah-day-one-jenny-marmorstein-1965/page/n35.jpg" xml:lang="en">After the evening prayer but before <tei:foreign xml:lang="he">עלינו</tei:foreign> the Kiddush is recited over a glass of wine. At home too, it is recited before the meal, but on the Sabbath preceded by <tei:foreign xml:lang="he">ויכלו</tei:foreign></tei:note>
        <j:transclude type="external" target="urn:x-opensiddur:text:siddur:rosh_hashanah/text/vayekhulu@prayerbook_for_the_new_year-heidenheim-1965-he"/>
        <j:transclude type="external" target="urn:x-opensiddur:text:prayer:kiddush/savri@prayerbook_for_the_new_year-heidenheim-1965-he"/>
        <j:transclude type="external" target="urn:x-opensiddur:text:prayer:borei_peri_hagafen@prayerbook_for_the_new_year-heidenheim-1965-he"/>
        <j:transclude type="external" target="urn:x-opensiddur:text:prayer:kiddush_rosh_hashanah@prayerbook_for_the_new_year-heidenheim-1965-he"/>
        <j:transclude type="external" target="urn:x-opensiddur:text:prayer:shehecheyanu@prayerbook_for_the_new_year-heidenheim-1965-he"/>
        <tei:note type="instruction" facs="https://archive.org/download/mahzor-lyom-rishon-shel-rosh-hashanah-day-one-jenny-marmorstein-1965/page/n35.jpg" xml:lang="en">After Kiddush at the meal, one recites <tei:foreign xml:lang="he">המוציא</tei:foreign> over the two loaves. After tasting the bread, one dips a piece of sweet apple in honey and says:</tei:note>
        <j:transclude type="external" target="urn:x-opensiddur:text:prayer:borei_peri_haetz@prayerbook_for_the_new_year-heidenheim-1965-he"/>
        <tei:note type="instruction" facs="https://archive.org/download/mahzor-lyom-rishon-shel-rosh-hashanah-day-one-jenny-marmorstein-1965/page/n35.jpg" xml:lang="en">Then one eats the piece of apple and says:</tei:note>
        <j:transclude type="external" target="urn:x-opensiddur:text:prayer:shetechaddesh_aleinu_shanah_tovah@prayerbook_for_the_new_year-heidenheim-1965-he"/>
        <tei:note type="instruction" facs="https://archive.org/download/mahzor-lyom-rishon-shel-rosh-hashanah-day-one-jenny-marmorstein-1965/page/n35.jpg" xml:lang="en">On the eve of the New Year, friends and acquaintances express their good wishes to one another in the following phrase:</tei:note>
        <j:transclude type="external" target="urn:x-opensiddur:text:siddur:rosh_hashanah/greeting@prayerbook_for_the_new_year-heidenheim-1965-he"/>
      </tei:div>
    </tei:body>

<tei:body xmlns:tei="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xmlns:j="http://jewishliturgy.org/ns/jlptei/2">

        <j:transclude type="external" target="urn:x-opensiddur:text:prayer:birkhot_hashachar/shelo_asani_goy@prayerbook_for_the_new_year-heidenheim-1965-he"/>
        <j:transclude type="external" target="urn:x-opensiddur:text:prayer:birkhot_hashachar/shelo_asani_aved@prayerbook_for_the_new_year-heidenheim-1965-he"/>
        <tei:div>
          <j:conditional xml:id="documentary_hashachar_men_he">
            <j:all>
              <tei:fs type="opensiddur:person">
                <tei:f name="gender">
                  <tei:symbol value="male"/>
                </tei:f>
              </tei:fs>
            </j:all>
          </j:conditional>
          <j:transclude type="external" target="urn:x-opensiddur:text:prayer:birkhot_hashachar/shelo_asani_ishah@prayerbook_for_the_new_year-heidenheim-1965-he"/>
          <j:endConditional target="#documentary_hashachar_men_he"/>
        </tei:div>
        <tei:div>
          <j:conditional xml:id="documentary_hashachar_women_he">
            <tei:note type="instruction" xml:lang="en">In place of the preceding benediction women say:</tei:note>
            <j:all>
              <tei:fs type="opensiddur:person">
                <tei:f name="gender">
                  <tei:symbol value="female"/>
                </tei:f>
              </tei:fs>
            </j:all>
          </j:conditional>
          <j:transclude type="external" target="urn:x-opensiddur:text:prayer:birkhot_hashachar/sheasani_kirtzono@prayerbook_for_the_new_year-heidenheim-1965-he"/>
          <j:endConditional target="#documentary_hashachar_women_he"/>
        </tei:div>

        <tei:div>
          <j:conditional xml:id="documentary_morning_qorbanot_shabbat_he">
            <tei:note type="instruction" xml:lang="de-Hebr">אַם <tei:foreign xml:lang="he">שַׁבָּת</tei:foreign> ווירד פֿאָלגענדעז איינגעסאַלטעט:</tei:note>
            <j:all>

clarifications.review_encoding: A mandatory canonical/encoding review gate. True means require a receipt, NOT review pending. Completion lives in reviews.json and is not encoded in this boolean.
clarifications.source_fidelity: Only canonical occurrence comparisons are auto-listed here. Literal source quotations are independently reviewed as XML and source blocks; an empty auto-comparison list is not an absence of source/semantic review.
clarifications.canonical_home: map_root false and omit_publication_urn true mean the GROUPING URN is not emitted as a whole-text identity or whole-publicationURN. Generic prayer milestones inside are the actual identities. No new prayer identity created for grouping.
clarifications.publication_urn: No requirement that every physical XML fragment have a whole-file publicationURN. Pure word collections containing independently addressed parts omit a false whole-text identity by design. Each emitted part uses generic corresp with project provenance. Structural files may hold only transclusions, with source pages in their children.
clarifications.legacy_metadata: Existing titles and language-specific wording selectors were already accepted and remain unchanged; first-printing wording selectors are not new canonical prayer identities. This batch adds only the shared non-language-specific teqiot_veseder_shofarot condition. Suggestions to migrate legacy names can be nonblocking followup; do not mint replacements contrary to user instruction to reuse existing identities.
clarifications.old_minchah: Weekday Minchah at the start of this festival book is the preparatory weekday Minchah, not the Rosh haShanah festival Amidah. The accepted legacy title has a slug suffix; canonical home title can be improved separately, but it is not pilot installment text.
clarifications.areshet_literal: The first printing keeps its original marked literal fragment; it does not assert that fragment is a canonical pointer. The two later printed occurrences point to the separately attested pure zikhron library. Both literal word and canonical pure word are independently source reviewed; no rule requires every literal prayer word to be replaced by a pointer.
